name: How long does it take to install new windows?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install new windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeframe depends on the number of windows, their size, and the complexity of the job. For a typical home, installation can range from one day for a few windows to several days for a whole-house replacement. We provide a projected timeline during the initial consultation, ensuring clear communication throughout the project to minimize disruption.
